meterCalibration._comments: strength, swr and power as reported in Hamlib. compression and alc PROVISIONAL, after Hamlib's scaling: COMP one dB a dot, ALC to the top of its zone at 30. Kenwood's TS-590S PC command reference gives SM0 (the S-meter while receiving, power out while transmitting) and RM (SWR, COMP and ALC, all three every time) as 0-30 dots and no scale. Replace with points read against a dummy load: the developer-mode meter capture prints the raw dots.
